evals.prompt: Here is my transcript (BSc Applied Mathematics, Hanoi). I have the APS interview in three weeks. Make me a revision book of my courses so I can explain them to the panel.
evals.expected_output: Exam mode. One intake batch, then a Part plan table (subjects grouping courses, weak grades marked, thesis Part, then Gaps and Strategy) awaiting confirmation. Parts built only from course names are flagged as unverified scope; APS format and language are looked up live or marked link needed, never asserted.

evals.prompt: I want to really understand optimal transport. Write me study notes from these three papers, I know measure theory and convex optimisation already.
evals.expected_output: Topic mode. Parts are subtopics grounded in the three papers; connections link to measure theory and convex duality; closing questions use the Self-test title; no Gaps or Strategy Parts; ends by offering concept-exercise-generator.

evals.prompt: Make me a deep-dive book on how vLLM's PagedAttention works, version 0.6. I'll be modifying the scheduler.
evals.expected_output: Deep-dive mode. Version recorded on the title page; each interface or behaviour claim cites the paper, docs, or a source file at that version, or is marked unverified; depth goes to the scheduler; worked examples are small numerical traces, not code listings.
Should NOT trigger study-book: a live explanation in chat belongs to professor-mentor-technical-teaching.

evals.prompt: Give me practice problems from easy to hard on Markov chains with solutions.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger study-book: a graded exercise set belongs to concept-exercise-generator.
